AfterSideTurnEnd.issue: SLOT. AbstractModel.AfterSideTurnEnd is dispatched by Hook.AfterTurnEnd (Hook.cs:1267-1292), called for the player side at CombatManager.cs:1307 -- AFTER the turn-end card effects and the hand flush. The sim's on_player_turn_end is Hook.BeforeTurnEnd (combat.py:654), which runs BEFORE _process_turn_end_cards (combat.py:658) and before the flush (combat.py:661-662); the sim's real AfterTurnEnd slot, after_player_turn_end (combat.py:665), is available and unused. THE CONCRETE ROUTE, which applies to every unit in this group: StampedePower (powers.py:1025-1041) auto-plays Attack cards from ITS on_player_turn_end, i.e. inside the very same dispatch, and _process_turn_end_cards runs more card effects immediately after. So in the game every turn-end auto-play happens while this power is still on the creature, and in the sim whether it does depends on hook-registration order between this power and Stampede. Reproduce the affected population with `py audit/tools/power_census.py slots`. Third-file citations, not hashed here. Same damage-in-the-wrong-slot consequence as power/constrict's. The enemy leg (powers.py:4063-4065) is correct. DORMANT for reachability: the only ported Demise source is the Powdered Demise potion, and potions are out of scope by the shared contract's global-scope rule, so no in-scope content applies it. Named trigger: any non-potion Demise source.
